_comment: Subway 'World Cup Week' scripted demo flow. Gated to SUBWAY_PHONE. Copy/steps are data-only; edit freely. Engine: src/scriptedFlow.js. Story: kickoff banner -> product swap -> discount pushback (40% asked, 20% HQ cap held) -> first-20-customers free-cookie special offer -> channel picker. Each banner's own message is addressed to the DEALER and sent BEFORE the image; the image's caption is the ready-to-forward CUSTOMER-facing copy, so dealer context and customer copy never land in the same bubble.
